title: O002-G2 Prospective Horizon Stress under Joint Unseen-Person × Unseen-Stimulus Holdout
purpose: Test whether the O002-G1 reported-state dominance and lack of physiology increment persist when the forecast target is moved farther into the future, reducing dependence on near-target autoregressive continuity.

horizon_construction.method: Within each subject×video sequence sorted by time_norm, predictors remain at row i and the target y_valence/y_arousal is taken from row i+h.
horizon_construction.rationale: The original physiology/prior windows end 1 s before anchor; shifting the target by h rows tests increasingly prospective forecasts without changing frozen predictor extraction.

outer_evaluation.unit: subject × video cell at each horizon
outer_evaluation.rule: For each test subject and test video, training excludes every row from the held-out subject AND every row from the held-out video.
outer_evaluation.video_identity: Omitted from all models because the test video is unseen.

prior: prior same-axis report from predictor row

learner.tuning: Training-only GroupKFold by subject, up to 4 folds; held-out subject and video never enter tuning.
learner.preprocessing: Median imputation and standardization fit only on each training fold.

primary_quantities.prior_increment: MAE(context_only)-MAE(prior); positive favors prior reported state.
primary_quantities.physiology_increment: MAE(prior)-MAE(physiology); positive favors physiology beyond prior report.

uncertainty.note: Each horizon/axis is reported separately. No positive claim may be made by cherry-picking across the six horizon×axis tests.

decisions.REPORT_PERSISTENCE_HORIZON_GENERALIZES: prior_increment 95% CI strictly above zero for both axes at all three horizons.
decisions.PHYSIOLOGY_INCREMENT_AT_ANY_HORIZON: At least one horizon×axis has physiology_increment 95% CI strictly above zero; classify as mixed and require independent replication before any positive physiology claim.
decisions.NO_PHYSIOLOGY_INCREMENT_ACROSS_HORIZONS: No horizon×axis has physiology_increment 95% CI strictly above zero.
decisions.STRONG_PHYSIOLOGY_DEGRADATION_ACROSS_HOR: All six physiology_increment 95% CIs are strictly below zero.

firewalls: Post-primary robustness analysis; it cannot redefine O002 primary.
Targets are shifted only within the same subject and video; no row crosses a video boundary.
This tests predictive information, not causal necessity or physiological irrelevance.
A null physiology increment at longer horizons does not imply physiology lacks affect-related signal.
publication_role: Direct manuscript-level horizon/leakage stress test of the narrow incremental-information claim.
